items.title: How to Turn a Business Question Into a Strategy Deck With ChatGPT Work | Tutorial
items.content_snippet: Turn a business question into a clear recommendation—without spending days gathering research and building slides. In this demo, Arvind from OpenAI’s Strategy & Business Operations team shows how he uses ChatGPT Work to pull together market research, customer data, and past strategy work; propose a storyline; and create a leadership-ready strategy deck. items.content_snippet: Turn scattered launch materials into a solid first draft. items.title: How to Prepare for Customer Meetings With ChatGPT Work | Tutorial

Alex from OpenAI’s Sales team shows how he uses ChatGPT Work to gather account context and create a meeting brief. After the call, ChatGPT Work drafts notes, a follow-up email, and proposed CRM updates for his review.. The result: less time managing the process and more time with customers. https://chatgpt.com/work
